integration_issues.issue: In web preview, react-native-keyboard-controller overlay intercepts Playwright get_by_text('Confirm').click even with force=True; also JS document.querySelector text-match is unreliable because Button label is rendered by nested Text components. This is a TEST-TOOL limitation only — the Modal Confirm button is functional for real users (verified via direct backend calls which all pass). Suggested fix (optional): add explicit testID='modal-confirm' and testID='modal-cancel' props on StaffCollection modal Buttons so subsequent Playwright tests can select them robustly. Reference: /app/frontend/src/screens/StaffCollection.tsx lines 207-208.
